title: Setting up the Weaviate Store: Part I

cues.en: So we have Weave V8 up and running in Docker Compose, we've installed the necessary dependency, and we've set up this config.py.
cues.zh: Weaviate 已在 Docker Compose 中執行，必要相依套件也已安裝，config.py 也設定好了。

cues.en: These four new fields we set up up here, and then we process them in load config down here.
cues.zh: 上面新增這四個欄位，下面在 load_config 處理它們。

cues.en: I said I wasn't going to put anything in the .on, but you know what? I'm going to.
cues.zh: 我原本說不加到 .env，但想想還是加上好了，

cues.en: It's just going to take a second.
cues.zh: 只要一下子。

cues.en: So let's open up the .on file.
cues.zh: 開啟 .env，

cues.en: First thing I'll do is right here, VectorStore, let's put a comment in there.
cues.zh: 首先在這裡的 VECTOR_STORE 加上註解，

cues.en: So a hash mark, and then hostgres, or Weave V8.
cues.zh: 用井字號，寫 postgres 或 weaviate，

cues.en: Those are the only things we're going to support.
cues.zh: 目前只支援這兩種。

cues.en: And then we have all our postgres configurations, and then I'll just paste in what I have copied to my clipboard.
cues.zh: 下面已有 Postgres 設定，再貼上我複製到剪貼簿的內容，

cues.en: No sense in you watching me type this.
cues.zh: 沒有必要看我一個字一個字輸入。

cues.en: All it is is a simple comment that says when we're using VectorStore Weave V8, how to start Docker Compose, and then the values, the default values are what we specify here
cues.zh: 只是簡單註解，說明使用 VECTOR_STORE=weaviate 時如何啟動 Docker Compose，再列出這四個環境變數的

cues.en: for the four environment variable entries, okay?
cues.zh: 預設值，與這裡指定的相同。

cues.en: Just to have it documented.
cues.zh: 只是把它記錄下來。

cues.en: Okay, so that's done.
cues.zh: 好了，完成。

cues.en: Now we get to the heavy lifting.
cues.zh: 現在進入主要工作。

cues.en: So we have, for example, over here, postgres.py.
cues.zh: 例如這裡的 postgres.py，

cues.en: And that, this postgres store, it satisfies all the requirements specified over here in the abstract interface, okay, for VectorStore.
cues.zh: 它的 PostgresStore 滿足 VectorStore 抽象介面的全部要求，

cues.en: So it must have these methods, and we're going to need to do exactly the same thing for Weave V8.
cues.zh: 所以必須有這些方法。Weaviate 也要做完全相同的事。

cues.en: So let's go right click on stores and create a new file, and we'll call this one Weave V8.py, okay?
cues.zh: 對 stores 按右鍵新增檔案，命名為 weaviate.py。

cues.en: And this is not difficult at all.
cues.zh: 這一點也不難。

cues.en: So before we actually start writing the code, let's just think about why one would want to use Weave V8.
cues.zh: 不過真正寫程式前，先想想為什麼要用 Weaviate。

cues.en: Well, to start with, Weave V8 is a purpose-built vector database.
cues.zh: 首先，Weaviate 是專門為向量打造的資料庫，

cues.en: This is what it's for.
cues.zh: 用途就是如此，

cues.en: It's only for vector information.
cues.zh: 專門處理向量資訊。

cues.en: Whereas postgres is a relational database with a vector extension.
cues.zh: 相較之下，Postgres 是附加向量擴充功能的關聯式資料庫。

cues.en: Weave V8 does give us something that I must confess is extremely helpful.
cues.zh: 我得承認，Weaviate 提供一個非常有幫助的功能，

cues.en: It has a native hybrid search.
cues.zh: 就是原生混合搜尋。

cues.en: Remember when we set up that hybrid search, that long block of SQL, where we did the dense search, then we did the next search, then we fused them together,
cues.zh: 還記得我們實作混合搜尋的那大段 SQL 嗎？先做稠密向量搜尋，再做詞彙搜尋，融合兩者，

cues.en: then we did the select on our fused data set?
cues.zh: 然後對融合資料集執行 SELECT。

cues.en: Well, this is built right into Weave V8.
cues.zh: Weaviate 已內建這些功能，

cues.en: We don't have to write that logic, okay?
cues.zh: 不必自己寫那套邏輯。

cues.en: So that's one thing that's very helpful.
cues.zh: 所以這非常有幫助。

cues.en: And the second thing that Weave V8 brings to the table is, well, it doesn't use schemas.
cues.zh: Weaviate 的第二個特性，是它不採用關聯式結構綱要的模式，

cues.en: It's an object-oriented mental model.
cues.zh: 而是物件導向的思考模型。

cues.en: It's just collections of objects with properties and a vector.
cues.zh: 只有物件集合，每個物件有屬性和向量，

cues.en: That's all that it is, okay?
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: So you don't need to build tables or indices or things like that.
cues.zh: 因此不必自己建資料表、索引等東西。

cues.en: It also, as I said a little while ago, it supports gRPC for the query path, and that's faster than HTTP, but only for batches.
cues.zh: 另外剛才也說過，它支援以 gRPC 查詢，批次操作時比 HTTP 快，

cues.en: Otherwise, they're pretty much comparable, okay?
cues.zh: 其他情況則大致相當。

cues.en: Now, the trade-off, of course, is that a lot of people already have postgres up and running and they already know SQL.
cues.zh: 當然，取捨在於很多人原本就有 Postgres，也已熟悉 SQL，

cues.en: No problem with that at all.
cues.zh: 這完全沒有問題。

cues.en: So what it comes down to is what works for you.
cues.zh: 所以最終取決於什麼適合你。

cues.en: Are you comfortable with supporting another component in your application, so you have postgres and you have Weave V8?
cues.zh: 是否願意替應用程式多維護一個元件，同時有 Postgres 和 Weaviate？

cues.en: Are you comfortable writing Weave V8 code, which as you'll see is not that difficult at all?
cues.zh: 是否願意寫 Weaviate 程式碼？等一下會看到，其實一點也不難。

cues.en: Or will postgres do the job for you?
cues.zh: 還是 Postgres 就已足夠？

cues.en: And I freely confess that in the vast majority of cases, when I'm using a vector database, my go-to solution is postgres.
cues.zh: 我坦白承認，在絕大多數需要向量資料庫的情況，我的首選仍是 Postgres。

cues.en: Now, I've used Weave V8 before and there's no problem using it whatsoever.
cues.zh: 不過我也用過 Weaviate，使用上完全沒有問題，

cues.en: It's a great solution.
cues.zh: 它是很好的解決方案。

cues.en: In any case, let's get started writing some code and we'll satisfy the contract defined over in base.py.
cues.zh: 總之開始寫程式，滿足 base.py 定義的契約。

cues.en: I'm going to start with my imports as I usually do.
cues.zh: 照例先匯入需要的項目，

cues.en: And I know I'm going to use annotations, no question.
cues.zh: 確定會用到 annotations，

cues.en: We'll need to import annotations, okay?
cues.zh: 所以需要匯入 annotations，

cues.en: I'm going to use that.
cues.zh: 之後會使用它。

cues.en: I'm also going to be using JSON, so I'll import JSON, which I have to spell right.
cues.zh: 也會使用 JSON，因此匯入 json，注意拼字，

cues.en: Okay, we're going to be using that.
cues.zh: 它也會用到。

cues.en: And I'm going to be having that ingested at timestamp, so from date time.
cues.zh: 另外會有 ingested_at 時間戳記，所以從 datetime，

cues.en: I'll import date time.
cues.zh: 匯入 datetime，

cues.en: And I'm also going to import time zone and you'll see why later on, okay? Right there.
cues.zh: 也匯入 timezone，稍後會知道原因，就在這裡。

cues.en: And we need typing, from typing.
cues.zh: 還需要 typing，從 typing，

cues.en: We'll need to import, I just want any, that's all I'm interested in.
cues.zh: 只需要匯入 Any。

cues.en: And now we need to import Weave V8.
cues.zh: 現在要匯入 weaviate，

cues.en: Obviously, we're not going to be able to use Weave V8 without that dependency.
cues.zh: 顯然少了這個相依套件就無法使用 Weaviate。

cues.en: And then specifically from Weave V8, I'm going to say from Weave V8.classes.config, I'm going to import configure to configure my store,
cues.zh: 接著從 weaviate.classes.config 匯入 Configure，用來設定儲存區，

cues.en: data type, so we need to specify data types and properties.
cues.zh: 以及 DataType，因為要指定資料型別，還有 Property。

cues.en: Well, each entry in the database has a property, okay?
cues.zh: 資料庫裡每筆資料都有屬性。

cues.en: And we're also going to want from Weave V8.classes.query, because we have to query this.
cues.zh: 也需要從 weaviate.classes.query 匯入，因為必須查詢，

cues.en: We're going to import, we want to be able to filter our results.
cues.zh: 我們希望能篩選結果，所以匯入 Filter，

cues.en: We want to use hybrid fusion, okay?
cues.zh: 也要使用 HybridFusion，

cues.en: That's exactly the same sort of thing for our hybrid retrieval that we set up in Postgres.
cues.zh: 用途正如我們先前在 Postgres 實作的混合檢索，

cues.en: And we want metadata query because we have metadata, okay?
cues.zh: 以及 MetadataQuery，因為會有中繼資料。

cues.en: And then from our local code, from.base, okay?
cues.zh: 接著從本機的 .base，

cues.en: Our contract, we're going to import, well, we need search hit, we need stored chunk and we need vector store, okay?
cues.zh: 也就是契約，匯入 SearchHit、StoredChunk 和 VectorStore。

cues.en: So the imports in a lot of ways are very similar to what we did with Postgres, but instead of the Postgres specific stuff, we have the Weave V8 specific stuff, okay?
cues.zh: 所以匯入在很多方面與 Postgres 很像，只是把 Postgres 專用內容換成 Weaviate 專用內容。

cues.en: And now we need a class.
cues.zh: 接著需要類別，

cues.en: We're going to call this one, well, a good name I think would be Weave V8 store.
cues.zh: 我想很適合命名為 WeaviateStore，

cues.en: And of course that takes vector store, okay?
cues.zh: 當然繼承 VectorStore。

cues.en: So this is a vector store backed by a single Weave V8 collection, okay?
cues.zh: 這是一個使用單一 Weaviate 集合的向量儲存區。

cues.en: And a collection is very much like a database in Postgres.
cues.zh: 集合很像 Postgres 裡的資料庫。

cues.en: So we need to set up some properties on the Weave V8 object.
cues.zh: 我們需要設定 Weaviate 物件的屬性，

cues.en: And we could do that right in the code itself, but I find it more convenient to centralize these as constants.
cues.zh: 也可以直接在程式碼中寫，但我覺得集中定義成常數比較方便。

cues.en: So if we have a typo anywhere, we're going to get named errors instead of a silent field not found error from Weave V8, okay?
cues.zh: 如此只要有任何拼字錯誤，就會得到 NameError，而不是由 Weaviate 默默回報找不到欄位。

cues.en: So we're just going to set them up.
cues.zh: 因此先把常數設定好，

cues.en: And there's quite a few of them.
cues.zh: 數量有好幾個。

cues.en: So p underscore source,
cues.zh: 首先是 P_SOURCE，

cues.en: underscore path.
cues.zh: 再接 _PATH，

cues.en: I want to make that equal to source underscore path, okay?
cues.zh: 把它設為 "source_path"。

cues.en: And I'm just starting with p underscore because it's a property.
cues.zh: 前面用 P_，只是因為代表 property，

cues.en: That's the only reason I put that there.
cues.zh: 沒有其他原因。

cues.en: Then p underscore content, underscore hash.
cues.zh: 接著 P_CONTENT_HASH，

cues.en: So we have content hash, so we have to keep track of that.
cues.zh: 我們有內容雜湊，必須記錄，

cues.en: And that's going to be content underscore hash, okay?
cues.zh: 值就是 "content_hash"。

cues.en: Then p underscore chunk underscore index.
cues.zh: 接著 P_CHUNK_INDEX，

cues.en: Of course, that's going to be chunk index.
cues.zh: 當然就是 "chunk_index"。

cues.en: What else do we have?
cues.zh: 還有什麼？

cues.en: Well, we have the content itself, p underscore content.
cues.zh: 有內容本身，所以 P_CONTENT，

cues.en: And that will be equal to, well, just content.
cues.zh: 值就設為 "content"，

cues.en: That's what we're calling it, okay?
cues.zh: 這就是它的名稱。

cues.en: And then we have the chunk metadata.
cues.zh: 接著是區塊中繼資料，

cues.en: So p underscore chunk underscore metadata.
cues.zh: 所以 P_CHUNK_METADATA，

cues.en: And of course, that's just called chunk metadata.
cues.zh: 當然叫 "chunk_metadata"，

cues.en: That's what we'll call it, but I have to spell it right, metadata.
cues.zh: 這是我們要用的名稱，不過 metadata 得拼對。

cues.en: Metadata is one of those words I always type wrong on the first try.
cues.zh: metadata 是我第一次輸入幾乎一定會拼錯的詞，

cues.en: And as you may have noticed, that's a fairly long list.
cues.zh: 你可能也注意到，這類詞其實不少。

cues.en: Then we have p underscore document underscore metadata.
cues.zh: 接著 P_DOCUMENT_METADATA，

cues.en: Did it right on the first try, but then I screwed up the equal sign.
cues.zh: 這次第一次就拼對，但卻把等號打錯，

cues.en: It's that kind of day.
cues.zh: 今天就是這樣。

cues.en: This will be document underscore metadata, okay?
cues.zh: 值是 "document_metadata"。

cues.en: What else do we have?
cues.zh: 還有什麼？

cues.en: Ingested at, p underscore ingested at underscore at, like that, okay?
cues.zh: ingested_at，所以 P_INGESTED_AT，

cues.en: And that will just be ingested at.
cues.zh: 值就是 "ingested_at"。

cues.en: And the last one is chunk count.
cues.zh: 最後是區塊數量，

cues.en: So p underscore chunk underscore count.
cues.zh: 所以 P_CHUNK_COUNT，

cues.en: And that is equal to just chunk underscore count.
cues.zh: 等於 "chunk_count"。

cues.en: I've set up my constants.
cues.zh: 常數都設定好了。

cues.en: Now, this is a class and it's going to require an init function.
cues.zh: 這是一個類別，因此需要初始化方法，

cues.en: So def underscore underscore init underscore underscore, okay?
cues.zh: 也就是 def __init__。

cues.en: And for parameters, and I'll put these on separate lines, obviously self and the host, which is a string, okay?
cues.zh: 參數分行寫，當然有 self，還有字串 host，

cues.en: And then a comma. And HTTP port,
cues.zh: 加逗號，再來是 http_port，

cues.en: which is typed into an int.
cues.zh: 型別標註為 int，

cues.en: And gRPC port, which is also an int.
cues.zh: 以及同樣為 int 的 grpc_port，

cues.en: And the collection name.
cues.zh: 還有集合名稱，

cues.en: So collection, which is a string, okay?
cues.zh: 也就是字串 collection。

cues.en: And this doesn't return anything. So none.
cues.zh: 沒有回傳值，所以是 None，

cues.en: And then a colon.
cues.zh: 接著冒號。

cues.en: And now we just set the various values. So let's host.
cues.zh: 現在設定各種值，先是主機，

cues.en: Self dot underscore host is equal to host, okay?
cues.zh: self._host = host。

cues.en: And self, and on the next line, self dot underscore HTTP port.
cues.zh: 下一行是 self._http_port，

cues.en: Well, that's going to be HTTP underscore port, okay?
cues.zh: 值等於 http_port，

cues.en: And that should be an equal sign.
cues.zh: 這裡應該是等號，

cues.en: Perfect. Next line.
cues.zh: 很好，下一行，

cues.en: Self underscore self dot underscore gRPC port.
cues.zh: self._grpc_port，

cues.en: That's going to be equal to gRPC port right there.
cues.zh: 它等於 grpc_port。

cues.en: And the next one is self dot underscore collection name, collection.
cues.zh: 下一項是 self._collection_name，

cues.en: Actually, I'll call it collection name, why not?
cues.zh: 就叫 collection_name，為什麼不呢？

cues.en: Collection name equals, and we can just use collection here, okay?
cues.zh: collection_name 的值可以直接使用 collection。

cues.en: And then we need one more.
cues.zh: 然後還需要一項，

cues.en: And of course, that's the actual client, right?
cues.zh: 當然是真正的用戶端。

cues.en: So the client for this, self dot underscore client, well, we get that.
cues.zh: 因此 self._client，

cues.en: It's typed into weviate dot weviate client.
cues.zh: 型別標註為 weaviate.WeaviateClient，

cues.en: Right there, okay?
cues.zh: 就在這裡，

cues.en: That package we imported.
cues.zh: 也就是剛匯入的套件。

cues.en: And then we'll put a, or none equals none, okay?
cues.zh: 再允許 None，初始值設為 None。

cues.en: So there's our init function. Very simple.
cues.zh: 初始化方法完成，非常簡單。

cues.en: Now we'll do one more, and then we'll break the rest of them up into individual lectures, so it's easier for you to find things when you come back.
cues.zh: 再做一個方法，其餘拆成獨立講座，方便日後回來尋找。

cues.en: Let's just set up the connect method.
cues.zh: 先建立連線方法，

cues.en: We need a method to connect to weviate.
cues.zh: 需要能連接 Weaviate 的方法，

cues.en: So we'll call it underscore connect, and it takes self, okay?
cues.zh: 所以叫 _connect，接收 self，

cues.en: And what it's going to return is a weviate. Try that again.
cues.zh: 它要回傳 weaviate，重新輸入一下，

cues.en: Weviate dot weviate client, right there.
cues.zh: 是 weaviate.WeaviateClient，

cues.en: We're gonna send that back, okay?
cues.zh: 將它回傳。

cues.en: And this is really simple.
cues.zh: 內容非常簡單。

cues.en: This is a lazy connect on first use.
cues.zh: 第一次使用時才延遲建立連線，

cues.en: We don't need a connection until we need to connect to weviate.
cues.zh: 直到真的需要連接 Weaviate，才需要連線。

cues.en: So we just lazy connect, and we ensure that the collection exists, okay?
cues.zh: 因此延遲連線，並確保集合存在。

cues.en: Unlike Postgres, where you have to, you know, get your connection, and you have to have that database in existence before you can do anything useful with that collection,
cues.zh: 不像 Postgres，要先取得連線，資料庫也必須已經存在，才能有效操作，

cues.en: weviate just says, here's a connection, and you want a collection called PyRegChunk?
cues.zh: Weaviate 會說：連線在這裡，你要一個叫 PyRagChunk 的集合嗎？

cues.en: I don't see one.
cues.zh: 我沒看到，

cues.en: Let me fix it for you.
cues.zh: 讓我替你處理，

cues.en: I'll create one.
cues.zh: 我來建立它。

cues.en: Now, let's define the actual function itself.
cues.zh: 現在定義實際函式，

cues.en: And it's really simple.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: One of the things to bear in mind about weviate is that it lazy connects on first use.
cues.zh: 要記得 Weaviate 在第一次使用時才延遲連線。

cues.en: You don't need to have the collection.
cues.zh: 不必事先有集合，

cues.en: You don't need to have a connection.
cues.zh: 也不必事先有連線，

cues.en: You can just call the client.
cues.zh: 直接呼叫用戶端即可。

cues.en: And if the connection doesn't exist, it gets one for you.
cues.zh: 如果連線不存在，它會替你取得，

cues.en: And if the collection, remember the one that's analogous to a database in Postgres?
cues.zh: 如果集合，也就是類似 Postgres 資料庫的那個單位，

cues.en: If that doesn't exist, it creates it for you.
cues.zh: 不存在，也會替你建立。

cues.en: So, first thing we'll do is check.
cues.zh: 所以首先檢查，

cues.en: If self.__client is none, we don't have a client yet, or not self.__client,
cues.zh: 如果 self._client 是 None，代表還沒有用戶端，或 not self._client，

cues.en: which I have to spell right, and then we call .is__connected, if either of those things evaluate to true, then we don't have a connection
cues.zh: 注意拼字，再呼叫 .is_connected()，如果其中一個條件為 True，表示沒有連線

cues.en: or we don't have a collection, okay?
cues.zh: 或還沒有集合，

cues.en: So, we'll just create the client.
cues.zh: 就直接建立用戶端。

cues.en: So, we'll use self.__client, okay?
cues.zh: 因此使用 self._client，

cues.en: We're going to set that to, and we'll just call weviate, .
cues.zh: 將它設為呼叫 weaviate，

cues.en: And we're going to connect to local.
cues.zh: 的 connect_to_local。

cues.en: There's a bunch of ways to connect to weviate.
cues.zh: 連接 Weaviate 的方式有很多，

cues.en: You can see here, you have connect to custom, if you have your own custom connection, or to an embedded version, or to the local, that's the one we're going to use, plus these other two, okay?
cues.zh: 這裡有 connect_to_custom，自訂連線；也有嵌入式版本、本機版本，我們要用本機，還有另外這兩種。

cues.en: Well, we only care right now about connecting to a local one.
cues.zh: 目前只需要關心本機連線。

cues.en: The logic to connect to the cloud, for example, it's well-documented and it's not difficult at all.
cues.zh: 例如連到雲端的方式，文件寫得很清楚，也完全不難。

cues.en: So, we'll say connect to local.
cues.zh: 所以使用 connect_to_local，

cues.en: Let's come down here, connect to local, okay?
cues.zh: 到下面呼叫 connect_to_local，

cues.en: And we'll open our parentheses and hit return to get to the next line, and we set some parameters.
cues.zh: 加上左括號，換行設定幾個參數。

cues.en: Well, what are we connecting to? The host.
cues.zh: 要連到哪裡？主機，

cues.en: Well, that's equal to self.__host, okay?
cues.zh: 它等於 self._host。

cues.en: And what's our web port?
cues.zh: 網頁服務的連接埠是多少？

cues.en: So, port equals, and again, that's just self.__http port, right there.
cues.zh: port 等於 self._http_port，

cues.en: And the last one is the grpc port, grpc port, right there, is equal to self.__grpc port, right there, okay?
cues.zh: 最後是 grpc_port，等於 self._grpc_port。

cues.en: So, that sets up the client.
cues.zh: 這樣就設定好用戶端。

cues.en: Now, after that, we'll come down here, and we need to make sure the collection exists.
cues.zh: 接著往下，必須確認集合存在。

cues.en: And I can write all that code right in this method.
cues.zh: 可以直接在這個方法裡寫完整程式碼，

cues.en: I'm going to write a little helper one in a minute.
cues.zh: 但我等一下會寫個小型輔助方法，

cues.en: So, we'll make the call and we'll write the actual helper method shortly, okay?
cues.zh: 所以先呼叫，再稍後實作輔助方法。

cues.en: So, self.__insure, and this is the name that I'm choosing, collection.
cues.zh: 名稱我取為 self._ensure_collection，

cues.en: In other words, ensure the collection that we're going to store information in, ensure that exists.
cues.zh: 也就是確保要存放資訊的集合確實存在。

cues.en: And that doesn't exist right now, but it will shortly, okay?
cues.zh: 方法現在還不存在，但馬上就會有。

cues.en: Now, outside of the if statement, all we have to do is say return self.__client, okay?
cues.zh: 在 if 外面，只要 return self._client。

cues.en: Now, that's how you connect to it.
cues.zh: 這就是連線方式。

cues.en: And of course, that won't work without this method, def__insure collection, okay?
cues.zh: 當然，少了 def _ensure_collection 這個方法還不能運作。

cues.en: And it takes no parameters except for self because it's in a class, and it returns none.
cues.zh: 它除了類別慣用的 self 外不接收參數，也不回傳值。

cues.en: So, let's assert, built right into Python, assert self.__client is not none, okay?
cues.zh: 所以使用 Python 內建的 assert，assert self._client is not None。

cues.en: And since we're already having a client by the time we actually call ensure collection, we're pretty much safe with that, but we'll put that in there anyway, okay?
cues.zh: 真正呼叫 _ensure_collection 時已經有用戶端了，基本上很安全，但還是加上檢查。

cues.en: And now, on the next line, let's see if the collection exists.
cues.zh: 下一行看看集合是否存在，

cues.en: If self.__client.collections.exists, which is built right into our client, okay?
cues.zh: 判斷 self._client.collections.exists，這是用戶端內建功能，

cues.en: And we can give it the collection name, and that's stored in self.__collectionname, okay?
cues.zh: 傳入集合名稱，存放在 self._collection_name，

cues.en: And then a colon.
cues.zh: 再加冒號。

cues.en: So, this is an if statement.
cues.zh: 這是一個 if 判斷，

cues.en: If we already have that collection, we're done.
cues.zh: 如果集合已存在，就完成了，

cues.en: We just return, okay?
cues.zh: 直接 return。

cues.en: So now, our error up here, which didn't show up as an error because this is Python, not a strongly typed language, but in any case, there was an error here. That's gone.
cues.zh: 現在上面那個錯誤已消失；它先前沒有顯示為錯誤，因為這是 Python，不是嚴格型別的編譯語言，但原本確實有錯。

cues.en: But of course, we actually need to create that collection, okay?
cues.zh: 不過，若不存在，當然還是要建立集合。

cues.en: So, it's really easy to do that.
cues.zh: 這非常容易，

cues.en: We come down here, and I'll give myself some room, and all we have to do is define each property in the collection explicitly.
cues.zh: 在下面多留一點空間，只要明確定義集合中的每個屬性。

cues.en: And we do this so we get strong typing on writes and reads, and so that we V8 can index the right things.
cues.zh: 這麼做可讓讀寫有明確型別，也讓 Weaviate 為正確項目建立索引。

cues.en: And this is not hard, okay?
cues.zh: 一點也不難，

cues.en: We're just going to create a collection.
cues.zh: 只是建立一個集合。

cues.en: So, we say self.__, and we'll create the collection using our client, underscore client.
cues.zh: 使用 self._client，透過用戶端建立集合，

cues.en: That's our WeV8 client, and we call collections, and we call the method create, okay?
cues.zh: 這就是 Weaviate 用戶端，存取 collections，再呼叫 create。

cues.en: And we'll put this on multiple lines so it's easy to read.
cues.zh: 分成多行寫，方便閱讀。

cues.en: First of all, every collection has to have a name, okay?
cues.zh: 首先，每個集合都必須有名稱，

cues.en: So, name equals, well, we know what that is.
cues.zh: name 的值我們已經知道，

cues.en: That's in self, self.__collectionname. No problem.
cues.zh: 就是 self._collection_name，沒問題。

cues.en: Then a comma, okay?
cues.zh: 後面加逗號。

cues.en: Now, the next thing I'm putting in here is something called vector config.
cues.zh: 接著要加入的是 vector_config，

cues.en: WeV8 will actually take care of creating the vectors itself, but I'm not going to do that, okay?
cues.zh: Weaviate 可以自行產生向量，但我不打算這樣做。

cues.en: We're saying we supply the vectors, which I find much cleaner.
cues.zh: 我們會自行提供向量，我覺得比較清楚，

cues.en: It's easier to diagnose what's going on, and it doesn't turn WeV8 into a pure black box where magic happens, okay?
cues.zh: 也更容易診斷，避免 Weaviate 變成會神奇處理一切的黑箱。

cues.en: So, I'm going to say vector config equals, and I'm going to choose configure, which I imported a little while ago when I did my WeV8 imports, .vectors, right there,
cues.zh: 所以 vector_config 等於剛才匯入的 Configure，接 .Vectors，

cues.en: and I'm going to call .selfprovided with opening and closing parentheses, okay?
cues.zh: 再呼叫 .self_provided()，記得括號。

cues.en: So, we're going to supply the vectors, which I think is the right way to do it, and now we just list the properties.
cues.zh: 因此我們自行提供向量，我認為這是正確做法。現在只要列出屬性，

cues.en: So, properties, that equals, and we'll use it in square brackets so it's a list, and we'll put one property per line, and it's simple.
cues.zh: properties 等於方括號中的串列，每行一個屬性，內容很簡單。

cues.en: We just say property right there, which is a WeV8 type, okay, and then in parentheses, name equals, and here's where I use those constants I set up,
cues.zh: 呼叫 Weaviate 的 Property 型別，括號裡 name 等於先前設定的常數，

cues.en: and the first one was source path.
cues.zh: 第一個是來源路徑，

cues.en: So, self.sourcePath, right there, p underscore source underscore path, and that's going to be of data underscore type,
cues.zh: 所以 self.P_SOURCE_PATH，並指定 data_type，

cues.en: not date type, data type, data type equals, and we use the data types that are specific to WeV8.
cues.zh: 不是 date_type，是 data_type，值使用 Weaviate 專用的型別。

cues.en: We did the import of data type, so we'll say data type, and this one is text, but it's in all caps, okay, text.
cues.zh: 已經匯入 DataType，所以這一個用全大寫的 DataType.TEXT。

cues.en: So, that's my first one, so I specified that.
cues.zh: 這是第一個屬性，已指定完成。

cues.en: Now, I can just duplicate this line to save some typing, and my second one is p underscore content underscore hash, okay, and that also is of type text.
cues.zh: 現在複製這行省打一些字，第二個是 P_CONTENT_HASH，同樣是 TEXT 型別。

cues.en: So, we have the source path, we have the content hash, the next one is chunk index, okay, so I'll duplicate the line and say chunk underscore index,
cues.zh: 已有 source_path 和 content_hash，下一個是 chunk_index，複製一行，改成 chunk_index，

cues.en: p underscore chunk underscore index, and this one, it's not text, it's an int, again, in all caps.
cues.zh: 就是 P_CHUNK_INDEX，這個不是 TEXT，而是全大寫的 INT。

cues.en: Then I'll duplicate this again, and change p underscore chunk underscore index to p underscore content, and that's text, right?
cues.zh: 再複製一次，把 P_CHUNK_INDEX 改成 P_CONTENT，這是文字，對吧？

cues.en: So, change this to text, right there, and duplicate the line again.
cues.zh: 因此型別改成 TEXT，再複製一行。

cues.en: After content, what came after that?
cues.zh: content 後面是什麼？

cues.en: Chunk metadata, okay?
cues.zh: 區塊中繼資料，

cues.en: So, p underscore chunk underscore metadata, right there, and this, even though it's actually JSON,
cues.zh: 所以 P_CHUNK_METADATA。它雖然實際上是 JSON，

cues.en: it's a JSON serialized string we'll be storing, okay?
cues.zh: 但我們會存成 JSON 序列化後的字串，

cues.en: So, that's also of type text, and then we'll duplicate this again.
cues.zh: 因此型別也是 TEXT。接著再複製一行，

cues.en: Then we have the document metadata, so I can just change this to document, which I have to spell right, document metadata,
cues.zh: 然後是文件中繼資料，所以改成 document，注意拼字，document_metadata，

cues.en: and again, of type text because it's serialized JSON, okay?
cues.zh: 同樣是 TEXT，因為內容是序列化 JSON。

cues.en: And we'll duplicate this again.
cues.zh: 再複製一次，

cues.en: The next one was ingested at, p underscore ingested at, and that one, well, that's a date, so we put it in the type date, and again, that is a type specific to Weaviate,
cues.zh: 下一個是 ingested_at，也就是 P_INGESTED_AT，它是日期，所以使用 DATE，這也是 Weaviate 專用的型別，

cues.en: not the date time we have in Python.
cues.zh: 不是 Python 的 datetime。

cues.en: The last one is chunk count, so p underscore, try that again, p underscore chunk count, and that is of type integer, so int, okay?
cues.zh: 最後是區塊數量 P_CHUNK_COUNT，重新輸入一下，型別是整數，也就是 INT。

cues.en: And then down here, we'll close that off, and I think it's good practice to put a trailing comma, so I will, and that is done.
cues.zh: 接著在下面關閉串列，我覺得保留結尾逗號是好習慣，所以補上。完成了。

cues.en: So, what have we done so far?
cues.zh: 目前做了什麼？

cues.en: We've done our imports.
cues.zh: 已經完成匯入，

cues.en: We set up some contents that will make it easier to identify errors when something goes wrong.
cues.zh: 設定一些常數，讓問題發生時更容易識別錯誤，

cues.en: We set up our init function, specifying the host where Weaviate lives, what web port it listens on, what gRPC port it listens on, and the name of our collection, okay?
cues.zh: 建立初始化方法，指定 Weaviate 的主機、HTTP 連接埠、gRPC 連接埠，以及集合名稱，

cues.en: And we set all those values, and then we actually create a client here as well.
cues.zh: 設定這些值，並且也宣告了用戶端，

cues.en: We'll allow it to be none initially until we need it.
cues.zh: 在實際需要前，允許它一開始是 None，

cues.en: Then it's created using this connect function, okay?
cues.zh: 之後使用 _connect 建立它。

cues.en: When we connect to Weaviate, it checks to see if we don't have a client or if we don't have a connected client, okay?
cues.zh: 連接 Weaviate 時，會檢查是否沒有用戶端，或者用戶端尚未連線，

cues.en: If either of those things evaluate to true, we create the client, we ensure the collection exists, which calls this little helper method down here, and we return the client.
cues.zh: 若任一條件成立，就建立用戶端、呼叫下面的小型輔助方法確保集合存在，再回傳用戶端。

cues.en: So now, barring any typographical errors, we have a means of connecting to Weaviate, okay?
cues.zh: 因此，只要沒有打字錯誤，現在就有連接 Weaviate 的方法了。

cues.en: So next, we've got to start putting all the required functions in, like hasDocument and upsertDocument, okay?
cues.zh: 接下來要開始實作所有必要函式，例如 has_document 和 upsert_document，

cues.en: And we'll get started with hasDocument in the next lecture.
cues.zh: 下一堂先從 has_document 開始。
